plan.title: Validate release provenance in an isolated manual workflow

criteria.description: A manually dispatched validation-only GitHub-hosted workflow obtains short-lived identity only on the dedicated test ref and confirms the exact pinned source. It generates a test provenance bundle that verifies for the expected subjects, issuer, workflow, ref and commit.
The actual remote run rejects changed bytes, wrong signer identity, wrong source commit and absent evidence. Record the run SHA and outcome before closure.

limitations: Requires an approved public test attestation. There is no production signing, release publishing, tag or repository settings change. The isolated test identity cannot satisfy production policy.
